newsitem.title: UK: UK FTSE leaps to new high at open after Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: UK FTSE leaps to new high at open after Dow rally.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index leapt to record heights on Thursday, spurred by positive market reaction to a bundle of blue-chip results and the Dow's bullish response to comments by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.

"We've really gone roaring up," one dealer said. "Wall Street was good, the results have been good, it's shaping up to be a cracking day. The only problem would be if the early mark-up keeps buyers away."
By 0845 GMT the FTSE was at a new peak of 4,391.0, up 30.9 points. The FTSE 250 index of mid-cap stocks also hit a new record, climbing 15.4 points to 4,694.0.
